summary: Frontend-only regression test of the 0-indexed age (Day 0 = placement) fix in BBM. Verified Flock Forecast headline CURRENT AGE, per-shed 'Day N' badges, per-shed side panel standard-curve preview + Farm Buddy tips, individual shed detail forecast, Morts tab, Density tab, and Batch Results (EOB) tab across farm=north-creek and farm=default. All age numbers match (today - placementDate) with NO +1 offset. No NaN, no Infinity, no console errors.

verified_panels.shed_growth_side_panel_1_2: Renders D0..D180 axis, 'Day 172 standard ≈ 4,067g' label, Farm Buddy tip references Day 172. Side panel correctly reflects 0-indexed age.
verified_panels.individual_shed_detail_5_6: Opens Shed 5&6 detail, shows Day 169 correctly, no NaN/Infinity.
verified_panels.morts_tab: Loads without errors, calendar grid renders (weekly grid header shows date labels e.g. 'Mon 7 Sept', 'Tue 8 Sept' - no 'Day X' badges visible on the calendar header in current implementation, so nothing to cross-check numerically there; underlying getDayNum change is not user-visible on this view in current placement state).
verified_panels.batch_results_eob: Renders correctly on farm=default; not flagged for EOB Age column per scope note.

console_errors: 0 pageerrors, 0 console errors across all tested views on both farms.
critical_code_review_comments: MortsView calendar header renders date-only (e.g. 'Mon 7 Sept') with no visible 'Day N' badge in current UI state on north-creek - the getDayNum helper (~line 5923) was updated but is not surfaced in a place I could visually cross-check against Flock Forecast. Main agent may want to confirm getDayNum is actually rendered somewhere reachable; if it is and I missed it, ignore.
Cage Rating shows '—' (em-dash) on Flock Forecast headline when there are no weigh-ins - correct, no crash. The intentional '>0' guard on 39.5/age is preserved.
test_credentials: Owner magic-link via /api/auth/owner-magic?key=... (as provided) - works, session cookie set.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing north-creek and default farm data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 0-indexed age fix verified end-to-end on north-creek (6 sheds, 2 different placement dates: 20 Mar and 23 Mar 2026) and default. Math: today Sep 8 2026 - Mar 20 = 172d, - Mar 23 = 169d, both display correctly. Side panels, individual shed forecast, and Farm Buddy tips all reflect the 0-indexed age. EOB static Age column intentionally unchanged per scope.
